<thought>The previous search with bond criteria returned no templates. I will broaden the search by omitting bond specifications and only using the functional group changes, keeping the flavanone SMILES as the target molecule.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "O=C1OC(C2=CC=CC=C2)C2=CC=CC=C12",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["aromatic hydroxyls", "ketones"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["ether oxygens"],
    "bonds_formed": null,
    "bonds_broken": null,
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
